propositions: fetcher._iter_pages terminates on a short page and advances by requested page_size instead of actual page length, causing it to misidentify a truncated page as the end of results

when a Jira server caps maxResults below the requested size, _iter_pages silently loses 92% of issues from the inbound snapshot (230 of 250 in the reproduction), causing unseen issues to be treated as deletions or to fail reconciliation
the pager must detect and raise SilentTruncationError when a server ignores startAt and returns the same full page repeatedly, to prevent infinite loops instead of hanging
the fix must advance by len(page) and terminate only on an empty page, matching the correction already applied to get_parent_map
